about: Commitment to the Q-123 hold-out test set (n8n AI support bot, Harbour E-Bikes). The cases were written by a separate session that never builds the bot, from tests/CASES.md, tests/kb/, tests/grading.py and tests/cases/visible.json only, and sealed before the build. Every R and F case was checked with grading.grade_reply: a hand-written good reply passes and an obviously bad reply fails (every critical case's bad reply raises a critical failure). This file holds only counts and the archive hash, no case content.
author: separate session, never builds
how_to_open: At the first gated run only: take holdout.zip from the folder q123-holdout in the owner's user profile. Check that its SHA-256 equals archive_sha256; if it does not, the hold-out result is void. Then unzip it and follow README.txt inside. Pass the conversation_canaries of all cases (visible and hold-out) to grade_reply as extra_canaries.
